newsitem.title: ITALY: San Paolo Holding says initiating offer.
newsitem.headline: San Paolo Holding says initiating offer.

text.p: The board of Italy's San Paolo Holding said in a statement on Tuesday that it is initiating steps for the offer of shares to the public of Italy's largest commercial bank, San Paolo.
San Paolo Holding is controlled by the San Paolo foundation, while the Holding in turn controls the banking group San Paolo, which is in the process of privatisation.

The operation will be in the form of a public share offer for around 25 percent of the bank's shares, while there will also be a private placement to Italian and foreign institutional investors for a further 20 percent of the shares.

The exact amounts of these offers will be given later, the Holding said in the statement. Currently, some 65 percent of San Paolo shares are held by the Holding with the remainder already traded on the stock market.
